annotations.title: Moon phase, illumination, distance and next phases

description: Moon phase today and in detail: phase name and angle, illuminated fraction, age, distance, apparent size, the next new, quarter and full Moons, and the next perigee and apogee; with a place, moonrise and moonset. E.g. {datetime: '2026-01-03T12:00:00Z'}. For calendar, weather, photography and tide apps: phase (8 names), phase angle, illuminated fraction, waxing or waning, age in days since the new Moon, Brown lunation number, centre-to-centre distance in km and Earth radii, angular diameter, ecliptic position, the previous new Moon, the next four principal phases and the next perigee and apogee with their distances, to the second. With latitude/longitude: the Moon's altitude and azimuth there and that local day's moonrise, transit and moonset. Perigee and apogee match NASA/JPL Horizons to the minute. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/moon (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

datetime.description: The moment: UTC, an explicit offset, or local civil time at the place given by latitude/longitude. Default: now (UTC, to the minute).

elevation_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres (no terrain or horizon dip is modelled).

latitude.description: Optional: add the Moon's altitude and azimuth from this place and that local day's moonrise, transit and moonset.

timezone.description: IANA zone for local times, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates (with its historical DST rules).

name: moon_details

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

local.description: With latitude/longitude only: location, time zone, altitude, azimuth, above_horizon and that local day's rise, transit, set and state.

next_apogee.description: {utc, timestamp, distance_km} of the next farthest point (null when it falls after 2199-12-30).

next_perigee.description: {utc, timestamp, distance_km} of the next closest approach (null when it falls after 2199-12-30).

next_phases.description: The next new, first quarter, full and last quarter Moons in time order: [{phase, utc, timestamp}].

phase.description: name (new moon, waxing crescent... waning crescent), phase_angle (0-360), illuminated_fraction, waxing, age_days, lunation (Brown).

position.description: Geocentric apparent ecliptic_longitude and ecliptic_latitude, degrees.

previous_new_moon.description: {utc, timestamp} of the last new Moon (null within a month of 1800-01-01).

settings.description: Every convention: frame, phase angle, illumination, age, lunation, distance.

subject.description: The resolved moment ('time': input, UTC, Julian days, Delta T).

title: Moon phase, illumination, distance and next phases
